## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a CISSP-aligned runtime security program for serverless, multi-cloud environments with practical controls and tooling.

## Key Concepts

- Serverless security in a multi-cloud context
- Code signing and reproducible builds
- Artifact attestation and SBOM integration
- Ephemeral credentials and per-function least privilege
- Runtime enforcement and telemetry
- Cross-cloud auditing and centralized governance

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo attestation check for runtime
function verifyAttestation(artifact, signature, publicKey) {
  // verify SBOM presence, signature validity, and reproducible-build hash
  return isValidSignature(artifact, signature, publicKey) && hasSBOM(artifact) && isReproducible(artifact);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

}
